points.description: States one valid advantage of TiC/TiN coating precisely using the correct technical term, from the model answer: excellent wear resistance, thermal stability, low coefficient of friction, improved thermal transfer, or increased tool life.
points.partial_credit: Half only if the advantage is clearly the right one but loosely worded (e.g. 'lasts longer' without naming tool life or wear resistance).

points.description: The advantage is stated as a property or benefit of the coating on the cutting tool (e.g. reduces wear/friction on the tool, withstands cutting temperatures, extends tool life), with no wrong or contradictory statement alongside it.
points.partial_credit: Half if the link to the tool is only implied rather than stated.

rubric.notes: Full marks need one advantage from the model answer, named with the correct term (wear resistance, thermal stability, low friction coefficient, improved thermal transfer, tool life). Vague answers such as 'better' or 'stronger' earn nothing. Any wrong or contradictory statement given with the advantage, such as saying the coating lowers hardness, removes the marks for that point.
